newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Monday, with demand staying moderate on a lack of fresh leads, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening but lower than last Friday's close of 1,440-45 rupiah, while trades were also done at 1,430.
"The market was sluggish," one trader said. "There was some activity in the morning, but it petered out."
"The Malaysian market was very quiet because of a lack of fresh factors, and this had an impact on the local market," he said. "The on-going election campaign also kept things quiet."
The traders said election-related violence over the weekend had made some buyers cautious, but added that overall sentiment remained unaffected.
Supporters of the ruling Golkar party and minority United Development Party (PPP) clashed in several parts of the capital over the weekened, but the situation was calm on Monday.
Indonesians go to the polls on May 29, with the Golkar party widely expected to emerge victorious.
